note: Committed alone, before any scan of the carrier exists and before any contributor has replied to a request. No scan, photograph or reading of any carrier specimen was known when it was written. Results are added by a later commit and never next to this file's first version.

instruments_assumed.note: The contributor's own instrument and stated accuracy replace these when reported; the uncertainty rule below uses what is reported.

preferred.dimension: certified scale bar in the field (P3)
preferred.consequence: D01 becomes a check, C4 below

fallback.dimension: D01 measured by contact, three repeats
fallback.consequence: D01 sets the scale and is not a check; C4 is not run and the record says that the scale came from D01

registration.neither: A scan with neither a scale bar nor a contact D01 has no scale and cannot establish the interfaces.

checks.feature: diameter of a body-mounting hole: the hole the contributor measured, as shown in their photograph
checks.scan_measurand: diameter of the cylinder fitted to the bore wall on the fitted half of the scan; when the bore wall is not captured, the mean of the least-squares circles fitted to the hole's edge on both faces (ADR 0024 step 4)
checks.failure_means: the scan disagrees with contact measurement on this specimen; recorded as a contradiction, and D01-D07 fall back to the measurement plan's contact rule (ADR 0024 step 5)

checks.feature: diameter of an engine-mount hole: the hole the contributor measured, as shown in their photograph
material thickness at an attachment: the station where the contributor's caliper jaws sat, as shown in their photograph
checks.scan_measurand: distance between the planes fitted to the two faces at that station, along their mean normal (ADR 0024 step 4)

checks.applies_when: a certified scale bar sets the scale
checks.feature: centre-to-centre distance between the two body-mounting holes, left to right
checks.caliper_value: mean of the three repeats with a rule or caliper
checks.scan_measurand: distance between the points where the two fitted hole axes cross the plane fitted to the face the rule was laid on
checks.threshold_basis: twice the 0.5 mm resolution of the rule

deviation: scan minus caliper, in mm, reported for every check whatever its outcome

uncertainty_rule.rule: P5 step 2: T must be at least twice the caliper uncertainty u of the same dimension, otherwise the reference cannot decide.
uncertainty_rule.u: the larger of the instrument's stated accuracy (its resolution when no accuracy is stated) and half the range of the three repeats
uncertainty_rule.when_2u_exceeds_T: the check is reported not_observable with the reason 'reference cannot decide'; T is not widened

identification: Which hole or station on the scan each reading belongs to is written down, with its reasoning, in a commit after the scan arrives and before any deviation is computed (P5b). If it cannot be established, every candidate assignment is judged and all are reported; the passing one is never picked.

feature_acceptance.split: fitted and held-out halves by the parity of a hash of the vertex index, as split_halves in twins/935-cylinder-head-cad-twin/source/fit_features.py
feature_acceptance.meaning: at least 90 % of the held-out vertices within 0.5 mm of the fitted surface lie within 0.2 mm of it, and there are at least 100 of them
feature_acceptance.if_not_met: the feature stays unconfirmed; a check whose scan measurand depends on an unconfirmed feature is not_observable

outcomes.pass: |deviation| <= T and the features the measurand uses are confirmed
outcomes.not_observable: the scan holds no confirmed feature for the measurand, or the reference cannot decide; this is a result, not a pass (P5c)

verdict_rule: The scan establishes D01-D07 only if every check that applies passes. Any fail, or any not_observable, leaves D01-D07 on the measurement plan's contact rule, and the failed or unobservable checks are recorded as such.
fixed_rules: No rescaling, re-registration or dropped check after results are seen (P5 step 5, ADR 0024 step 5).
A caliper reading is never used to scale or register the scan; only a certified scale bar or, without one, a contact D01.
A feature the scanner did not see stays null with its reason; nothing is filled from a photograph, the PET drawing or a neighbouring feature.
A pass shows that the scan agrees with contact measurement on this specimen at T. It is not a scanner calibration, and it releases nothing: the structural route of SAFETY.md is unchanged.
